faq: Will a redesign affect my search rankings?
We aim to protect them by keeping addresses, titles and text where possible. Large layout changes can still shift rankings slightly, and no one can promise a particular result.
Do I need to bring a design?
No. Share sites you admire and your brand details and we propose the look. If you already have designs in Figma, we build to match them.
Can you redesign a site that is not on Framer?
Yes. We rebuild it in Framer, which counts as a redesign and a move together. Send your link and we confirm how much carries over.
How many design rounds are there?
Each package includes a set number of revisions, which are shown on the page. We share layouts early, so changes are cheap and nothing is a surprise at the end.

desc:
A Framer website redesign gives your current site a fresher look, clearer layouts and light motion, while keeping the wording and links that still work. Ecom Swift LLC rebuilds your pages in Framer, from an existing Framer site or another platform, and you approve a private preview before launch.

## What is a Framer website redesign?

A Framer website redesign is a new visual design for an existing site, built in Framer. It changes layouts, type, colors, imagery and motion. It does not start from nothing: your content, page addresses and search titles carry over wherever they still serve you.

We agree a design direction with you first, so the result matches your brand and audience rather than a generic style.

## Why a site needs a redesign

Sites age in a few ways. Design trends move on, and a site that looked sharp a few years ago may feel dated beside competitors. Pages grow by accretion, with sections added over time until the message is buried. Phone layouts, once an afterthought, now carry most visits and can be poor.

A redesign is a chance to fix these together. It lets you choose a clear structure, a consistent set of styles and a visual tone that fits where the business is now. It is worth doing when the site no longer reflects the quality of your work.

## How a redesign can change your results

Design shapes first impressions. A clear layout helps visitors see what you do and where to go next. Readable type and good spacing make long pages easier to finish. Strong, relevant imagery builds confidence in a way text alone cannot. Light scroll and hover motion can guide attention to the right place without slowing the page.

A redesign can also affect findability, for better or worse. If addresses change without redirects or titles are dropped, search visibility can suffer. We keep addresses and titles where they still make sense and redirect where they do not. No design change can promise a particular rise in traffic or sales.

## What a thoughtful Framer redesign includes

- A review of what already works, so good content is kept.
- A new visual direction: type, colors, buttons and spacing.
- Redesigned home page and key inner pages.
- A new navigation menu and footer.
- Layouts that adapt to phone, tablet and desktop.
- Refreshed images and icons that match the new style.
- Subtle scroll and hover animation with a calm pace.
- Redesigned CMS templates for blogs or work lists in larger packages.
- Page addresses and search titles kept or redirected.
- A style guide and before and after screenshots in the top package.

## How we work

We begin with a short conversation and a look at your current site. You tell us what you like, what bothers you, and which sites you admire. We propose a direction, then build the redesigned pages in Framer with a private preview link you can open at any time.

Basic gives your home page and one key inner page a new look. Standard redesigns a core set of pages with new navigation, footer, animation and refreshed images. Premium covers a complete redesign with custom sections and icons, new CMS templates, a one-page style guide, before and after screenshots and a period of fixes.

Nothing goes live until you approve it. If your site is on another platform, we rebuild it in Framer and plan the move with you.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Collect two or three sites whose style you like.
- Decide which pages must be in scope.
- Provide your logo and brand files.
- Gather the best photos you have.
- Give feedback in one consolidated list per round.

**Avoid:**
- Renaming page URLs and forgetting to map the old ones.
- Rewriting every page and redesigning at the same time.
- Using stock images that do not show your real work.
- Adding motion to every element.
- Asking for design changes after launch that belong in a new project.

## Who this is for

This service suits a business whose site no longer matches its brand, an agency or studio that wants a portfolio worthy of its work, and a company that has outgrown its first quick site. It also fits an owner who feels the content is good but the design holds it back.

## What we need from you

Send your current site address, logo and brand files, and a short note on what you want to change. Invite us to your Framer project as a collaborator, or let us create it in your account. We never ask for passwords.

Tell us who to contact for approvals, so feedback stays in one place.
